vulnerability.title: Linear Pool Composable Stable Pool Rate Provider Read-Only Reentrancy
vulnerability.rootCause: Rate provider queries scaling factors from child pools during active join/exit swaps before balance reconciliation.
vulnerability.attackVector: Flash loan executes asymmetric swap, reentering through custom rate provider callback to borrow at warped exchange rates.

remediationOpenZeppelin:
--- a/contracts/Vault.sol
+++ b/contracts/Vault.sol
@@ -150,3 +150,4 @@
+ require(!_isUnlocked(), 'Cannot query pool rate during unlocked vault context');
